rules.fill_works: called("fill") and reverted and (pre("offer", arg(0)) + pre("offer", arg(1)) < 128)
rules.place_works: called("place") and reverted and (arg(0) > 0 and arg(0) <= 100 and pre("offer", sender) == 0)
rules.fill_clears: called("fill") and ok and post("offer", arg(0)) != 0
rules.fill_clears_b: called("fill") and ok and post("offer", arg(1)) != 0
rules.place_exact: called("place") and ok and post("offer", sender) != arg(0)
rules.conserved: called("fill") and ok and post_sum("credit") + pre("totalPaid") != pre_sum("credit") + post("totalPaid")
